content.title: When Does ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Come Out? Full Release Schedule Revealed and How to Watch
content.text: HBO Max: Coming in 2026 Teaser TrailerDigital Spy GBLIVECurrent Time 0:03Total Duration 1:55Fans were left questioning what the hell was going on after not just one, but multiple cliff-hanger endings to Euphoria season 2. And now, Euphoria is back for its third season—bitch, we are definitely not joking.The second season of the hit HBO show came after a two-year-long wait. It saw Rue relapse and then go on a detox and Cassie go head-to-head with her sister onstage. Maddie finally got her talons into Cassie. Add in Nate calling the police on his own dad, Ashtray ending up locked in the bathroom with a bunch of guns and Elliot's six-minute song and it's hard to know what other chaos the show could possibly come up with for a whole other season.But it very much has come up with other chaos. And the latest season is coming to our screens very soon too, with Zendaya, Jacob Elordi and Hunter Schafer among the much-loved cast members making a return.The premiere of the season took place in Hollywood last night (April 7), with fans itching for an insight into the long-awaited season. Following in similar fashion to the second, season 3 has also taken a while to come out. Showrunner Sam Levinson revealed at the premiere the team was "trying to figure out how to find a way to pay respect to those who we lost," referring to the passing of actor Angus Cloud (who played Fezco) and Eric Dane (who played Cal).So, four years on from season 2's finale, which left fans rocked to their core, when can we expect Euphoria season 3?HBOWhat date does Euphoria season 3 come out?Euphoria season three is set to premiere on Sunday, April 12 in the US. Yes, you are very much correct, that is indeed just a few days away.It will run from April 12 through to May 31.Where can I watch Euphoria?You'll be able to catch new episodes of the HBO Original series on HBO Max.What time does Euphoria season 3 premiere on HBO?The first episode of season 3 will premiere on HBO at 9pm ET on April 13. New episodes will release at the same time every week, concluding on May .How many episodes are there in Euphoria season 3?Similarly to the other seasons, the new season is eight episodes.The full episode release schedule of Euphoria season 3Unfortunately, the names of the episodes are being kept under wraps, but you can expect them to release on the following dates:Episode 1 - airs April 12Episode 2 - airs April 19Episode 3 - airs April 26Episode 4 - airs May 3Episode 5 - airs May 10Episode 6 - airs May 17Episode 7 - airs May 24Episode 8 - airs May31And as to whether there's set to be a season 4? Well, Levinson told Variety there are currently “no plans” for a fourth. So it looks like you'll just have to make the most of season 3.Euphoria season 3 is available on HBO and HBO Max.
